title: Keep writes, reads and caches a repository can steer inside its Git work tree
description: Keep writes, reads and caches a repository can steer inside its Git work tree
acceptance_criteria: Every change-workflow, backup, registry, init, lifecycle, merge and generator write goes through the confined project helpers: a committed change.md or artifact link out, a dangling artifact link, a linked .specsync/changes, a linked .specsync/backup-fix and a linked .specsync under init-registry are refused with the path named, and nothing outside is written. Inside a Git work tree the helpers confine to the work tree's top folder, so a monorepo subproject's links that stay in the repository work; absolute links are refused as absolute links; a path into the Git directory (a .git component in any case, trailing dots or spaces stripped, or a link whose canonical target lies under git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir or a .git component) is refused as leading into the Git directory; a write opens without blocking and checks the handle is a regular file before truncating. A .specsync/hashes.json Git tracks is neither read nor saved: check validates every spec with one warning naming git rm --cached, rehash exits 1, and prune drops keys that leave the project. specs_dir, source_dirs and schema_dir must be relative paths inside the project without ..; spec discovery walks the confined handle within 100,000 entries and 256 levels; changelog skips a spec blob over 8 MiB at a ref with one warning; import --from-dir reads within the named directory with the 8 MiB bound. A source scan fails on any new direct write, rename or removal outside the helpers, and the read scan also counts fs::copy, OpenOptions reads, BufReader and io::copy. The new tests fail on the base with only the tests added and pass with the fix

answers.constraints: util.3md: stay inside the root by construction, and enforce the same rule wherever a path is read, written, walked or replayed. change.3md: a refusal is a result worth recording and names its recovery (#433, #847). A cache never needs a link, so both caches stay strict (Leif, 04:53Z). Leif's choices 1-8 (16:00Z) and point 6 (19:43Z) bound the scope; SpecSync's own .git writes (hooks install) keep their own paths.
